description:
Make room for more memories. Find duplicate and similar photos, review blurry shots and large videos, and clear the clutter with a personal cleanup plan.

KNOW WHERE TO START
See an estimate of the storage you could reclaim. Choose what you want to clean up and follow a plan based on your priorities.

KEEP THE PHOTOS YOU LOVE
Compare similar shots and keep your favorites. Review screenshots, bursts, Live Photos and photos saved from messaging apps in focused sessions.

SWIPE, THEN REVIEW
Swipe right to keep and left to mark for removal. Undo a swipe or restore an item from the in-app Trash Bin before you confirm deletion. You choose what goes.

FIND WHAT TAKES UP SPACE
Review large videos and unwanted images, with file details and cleanup progress to help you decide.

REVISIT YOUR MEMORIES
Browse by date, album or category. Memory Lane brings back photos from this day in previous years.

PHOTO ANALYSIS ON YOUR DEVICE
Your photos are not uploaded for scanning, duplicate detection or cleanup decisions.

START FREE
Pro unlocks unlimited swipes and advanced cleanup tools. Subscription and one-time purchase options depend on availability. The price and terms are shown before purchase.
